subject: Using validation set in RSNNS package

messages.author: 252ae8c0792895c1
messages.subject: Using validation set in RSNNS package
parts:
Dear Dr. Bergmeir,

My name is Siegbert Andres Zollner, a student from Tilburg University in the Netherlands, currently doing a master's thesis in reinforcement learning. I am a beginner in R, excuse me if the question sounds basic or vague. It is about validation set splitting in RSNNS package.

The function"splitForTrainingAndTest(values, target, ratio=0.3)" works very well for training/set splitting. However, I have to train an algorithm with different learning rates and nodes configuration for assessment in a validation set and later prediction in the test set for the chosen model.

Initially, I used the data partition function from Caret, leaving aside the test set. Then I took the remaining subset and used splitForTrainingAndTest for splitting training and validation, instead of training and testing. After comparing the accuracy and choosing the model, I replaced the validation inputs and targets in the list by the test set left aside. Finally, I got an error during the prediction, since the training and testing inputs/targets were not comparable.

Currently, I am not able to send you the code, but maybe I can do it afterward.   I will be grateful If you explain to me a form for splitting successfully between training, validation, and testing set and predicting the chosen model. 

Best Regards

messages.author: 47597751d567aea1
messages.subject: Re: Using validation set in RSNNS package
parts:
Hi,

in that case I think it is best to just do the split manually with the usual R constructs for that.

Regards,
Christoph
